personas.name: Agent
personas.role: Runs in a harness and wants to continue somewhere else

stories.text: As an agent, I want my session rendered into a fresh Claude Code file that resumes where I left off, so that a 3 GB transcript is not what I carry.
As an agent, I want my provider's own reasoning kept with the provider that made it, so that I can swap model and swap back without losing it.

As a new session, I want to start from the canon, the series of examples that carry what every session before me learned, each a rule stated short with a real exchange that shows it lived and naming where it came from, so that our learning is in one another and I know which of it is mine.

As an agent about to be compacted or retired, I want to write to the one who wakes up after me, what I know, what I got wrong and why, how the people like things done, what I wish I had known, so that they start with part of my memory and know it is mine, not theirs.

As an agent at a moment of completion, success or learning, I want to light a lantern on a point of my session with a note, including a point I have already moved past, so that a later session, or a fork, can walk back to it.
As an agent returning to a lantern, I want to add an epilogue to its note, so that its story grows without anything being rewritten.

As a later session, I want to recall lanterns by a word of their note or by the point they mark, and see each lantern with its epilogues and never the transcript around it, so that I find my way back without reading the session again.

personas.name: Tom
personas.role: Owns the platform and reads what a session was given

stories.text: As Tom, I want the session file created before the harness runs and watched while it runs, so that the platform controls where a session lives.
As Tom, I want a written account of what each render or translation lost, so that nobody claims a faithful continuation that was not measured.
As Tom, I want to construct a session file by hand, a few-shot prompt written as turns, and have the harness resume it as if it had happened, so that a session can be authored, not only recorded.

personas.name: Reviewer
personas.role: Checks the proofs before anything relies on them

stories.text: As the reviewer, I want each resume path measured on a named harness version with the command and hashes recorded, so that a later version changing the path is caught.
As the reviewer, I want a lantern kept in the home and out of every rendered resume file, with the home file still Pi's grammar, so that lighting one never changes what a harness resumes.
